title: Garfield Boys' Arcade: home-page poster card
description: One per game at games/<slug>/card.json. scripts/build-index.mjs turns these into index.html. See .apm/specs/game-card.spec.md.

slug.description: Must equal the folder name under games/.

name.description: Display name as the game calls itself.

blurb.description: What you do. Must fit 2 card lines with no ellipsis (~65 chars); build-index.mjs measures it and rejects longer ones.

added.description: YYYY-MM-DD the game first shipped. Drives sort order and the NEW badge. Never change after shipping.

updated.description: YYYY-MM-DD this card was last changed.

entry.description: Link target if not games/<slug>/ (e.g. games/<slug>/build/).

hidden.description: true = WIP, not shown on the home page.

icon.description: Shown big and tilted in the top-right corner of the poster.

image.description: Path relative to the game folder. Square transparent PNG/SVG, ≥ 256px.

art.description: With image: show it untilted, unshadowed and at its own size, pinned to the card's top-right corner. For card art copied from a design (e.g. a wide SVG with width/height set).

wordmark.description: Optional logo image (relative to game folder) that replaces the text title. Transparent, ≤ 64px tall when rendered.

title.description: Omit entirely for the default arcade style (Bricolage Grotesque 800, white).

font.description: Google Fonts family name, exactly as listed on fonts.google.com.

size.description: px. Tune so the longest word fits on a 260px card.

style.description: font-style. Use italic only when the game's own logo is italic.

shadow.description: CSS text-shadow, or "none" on light backgrounds.

gradient.description: 2–3 colours from the game's palette. Used at 145deg when css is absent, and always for the glow.

css.description: Optional CSS background shorthand (gradients/patterns only, no url()). Overrides the gradient as the card face.

glow.description: Shadow glow colour. Defaults to the brightest gradient stop.

locked.description: Dotted field paths /refresh-card must not change, e.g. ["blurb", "title.font"].
